The '''Velabri Lancers''' were a strike force consisting of the greatest warriors of the [[Velabri (species)|Velabri]]. It served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] out of gratitude for their efforts to free [[Velabri]].

[[Quillin Durand]] and his son, [[Quillin Arkell]], were both Velabri Lancers.
